subject: Mutual action plan: sprint cadence, security gates & retention (draft)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elan Roberts <elan@bridgestone.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: sprint cadence, security gates & retention (draft)

Hi Elan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our call I pulled a compact MAP that focuses only on the security/compliance gates you flagged: SOC 2 evidence intake, SIG/CAIQ completion, DPA redlines, and the data retention/residency decision. Attached is a one-page draft (draft_MAP_v0.9.pdf) and a proposed sprint cadence for the next 6 weeks.

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm the SOC 2 items you require (I mapped the full index to the SOC2_evidence_index.csv).
- Target date for SIG/CAIQ completion (we can split into two passes: technical answers first, legal validation second).
- Any non-negotiable procurement cutoffs (your procurement timeline file would be helpful).

Our proposed acceptance criteria (for gating the MAP close):
1) SOC 2: we upload requested artifacts and provide a SOC attestation summary (internal security owner: Marissa).
2) SIG/CAIQ: Redwood to complete answers within 7 business days of getting your initial Qs; Bridgestone to confirm in 3 business days.
3) DPA: legal redlines to be exchanged via DocuSign (we can pre-seed).
4) Data retention & residency: default is 180 days for token logs; if you need EU residency we’ll route to Private deployment (owner: Karthik will scope infra delta).

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (now): shared MAP + evidence index (attached).
- Week 1: Bridgestone returns SOC item list & CAIQ clarifications.
- Week 2–3: Redwood populates CAIQ, uploads evidence.
- Week 4: Legal exchange of DPA redlines.
- Week 5–6: Final acceptance + signoff.

If that aligns, we’ll lock owners and update the HubSpot record (deal RDW-2374). Can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether you require EU residency?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if useful.

—
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: draft_MAP_v0.9.pdf (1 page), SOC2_evidence_index.csv (stub)
From: Elan Roberts <elan@bridgestone.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: sprint cadence, security gates & retention (draft)

Lauren —

Thanks for this. Bridgestone is broadly aligned but a few clarifications before we confirm:

1) Procurement timeline: I attached the expected procurement timeline (bridgestone_procurement_timeline.xlsx). We need vendor contract signed by 2026-08-15 to hit our Q4 rollout. Can Redwood meet the acceptance window you proposed?

2) SOC 2: We have a short list of higher-priority artifacts (list inside the XLSX). For anything not publicly shareable, we’d accept a security owner call and a download of the evidence index.

3) SIG/CAIQ: We’d like an initial CAIQ pass within 5 business days and a technical deep-dive on 2026-07-12 (our security team). Will Marissa be available?

4) DPA & retention: Our default is 1 year retention for token logs; will that require a contract-level change or is it a deployment configuration? Also confirm whether EU data residency is required — for now we do not require EU residency but will confirm by 2026-07-02.

5) Can you provide a quick breakdown of what would push us to Redwood Private vs Hosted? (cost/lead time differences).

If that looks reasonable I’ll loop procurement (procurement@bridgestone.com) and schedule the security deep-dive for 2026-07-12.

Best,
Elan Roberts
Director, Cloud Platforms
Bridgestone Analytics
elan@bridgestone.com

Attachments: bridgestone_procurement_timeline.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan: sprint cadence, security gates & retention (draft)

Team — forwarding Elan’s reply. Quick internal notes before I respond:

- SOC 2 ownership: Marissa, can you confirm availability for the 7-day CAIQ turnaround and the 7/12 technical deep-dive? Also call out which artifacts are allowed to be redacted vs. which require a security call.
- DPA & retention: Karthik, customer asked for 12 month token retention as a preference. We currently default to 180 days on hosted; 12 months is doable but we should flag this as a legal/price deviation. Need to know whether this can be a config flag or requires contract-level change.
- Private vs Hosted: short answer for Elan — Private gives EU residency and physical isolation, plus a modest uplift in TCO and a 3–4 week provisioning lead time. We should quantify +$ per RU and lead-time explicitly before replying.

Proposed next actions (I’ll send this to Elan after we align):
1) Marissa confirms CAIQ turnaround + availability for 7/12.
2) Karthik confirms infra delta & quick ballpark cost for 12-month retention and Private option.
3) I’ll pre-seed the DPA via DocuSign and ask legal to expect redlines (deal RDW-2374).

Marissa — can you take SOC owner? If you’re swamped, suggest we bring on security_eng for the call but you lead the answers.

Thanks — I’ll aim to reply to Elan by EOD PT.

—
Lauren

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: sprint cadence, security gates & retention (draft) — confirmed owners & next steps

Elan —

Appreciate the quick turn. We’re aligned and I’ve locked owners and dates below so procurement has visibility.

Confirmed items:
- SOC 2 evidence / CAIQ: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) will own the CAIQ and the evidence intake. We’ll deliver an initial CAIQ pass within 5 business days (by 2026-06-29) and are booked for the technical deep-dive on 2026-07-12 (Marissa and one engineer).
- DPA & retention: We can support 12-month token log retention as a configurable option. That change does not require a separate physical deployment but does require DPA language to call out the retention SLA (I’ll pre-seed the DPA and route via DocuSign: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/RDW-2374-DPA). Legal will review any redlines; please expect exchange the week of 2026-06-29.
- Hosted vs Private: Karthik will provide a short cost delta and provisioning lead time (Private ~3–4 weeks; hosted available immediately).

Procurement note: you requested an execution by 2026-08-15 — that’s feasible if we complete the DPA and SOC acceptance by end of July. We’ll treat that as the MAP close target.

Next steps for Bridgestone:
1) Confirm EU residency requirement by 2026-07-02 (you indicated likely no).
2) Procurement to confirm the internal PO timing so we can line up DocuSign.

Next steps for Redwood:
1) Marissa to deliver CAIQ pass and evidence pointers by 2026-06-29.
2) Karthik to share cost delta for 12-month retention + Private option by 2026-06-25.
3) Lauren to send DPA draft today via DocuSign.

If that works I’ll update HubSpot (deal RDW-2374) and send a calendar invite for the 7/12 tech deep-dive (tentative).

Thanks and speak soon —
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
